_comment: Single source of truth for all published URLs of this course.
Read by website/build.py, lib/helpers.py, lib/helpers.R and notebooks/start.ipynb.
data_base_url points at the course website's own data/ directory: the
build copies data/*.csv|json|xlsx next to the lessons, so a learner's
copy-pasted pd.read_csv(...) fetches the same file the page documents.
No dependency on raw.githubusercontent.com and no second copy to keep
file_base_url prefixes every file reference in the lessons and the docs, so
a path such as `lib/helpers.py` links to exactly that file in the repository.
